{"summary": "The prod cluster scored 72.0 on NSA and 74.0 on MITRE in kubescape, with 6 and 4 failed controls respectively. The digest lists two failed controls in detail: C-0030 (ingress/egress not blocked, 8 resources) and C-0013 (non-root containers, 5 resources), both affecting shop/Deployment/web. The only admin binding shown is cluster-admin bound to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Image vulnerability scanning (trivy) did not run, so CVE exposure is unknown.", "targets": ["prod"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 15, "failed": 6, "skipped": 5, "score": 72.0}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 13, "failed": 4, "skipped": 5, "score": 74.0}], "findings": [{"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Workloads run without network policy isolation (ingress/egress not blocked)", "resource": "shop/Deployment/web (+7 other resources)", "controls": ["C-0030"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0030 'Ingress and Egress blocked' failed on 8 resources, with shop/Deployment/web given as an example.", "fix": "Add a default-deny policy per affected namespace, then allow required traffic:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
  namespace: shop
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Containers not enforced to run as non-root", "resource": "shop/Deployment/web (+4 other resources)", "controls": ["C-0013"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0013 'Non-root containers' failed on 5 resources, with shop/Deployment/web given as an example.", "fix": "Set in the pod spec:
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 10001
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters group", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "The rbac_and_argo data shows binding cluster-admin to role cluster-admin with the single subject Group system:masters, which matches the Kubernetes default and looks like a platform default; no other admin bindings or wildcard roles are listed.", "fix": "No change needed for the default binding. Restrict membership of system:masters (e.g. kubectl get clusterrolebinding cluster-admin -o yaml) and avoid issuing client certificates with that group."}], "not_checked": [{"item": "trivy k8s prod", "reason": "FATAL unable to initialize a Kubernetes client: context deadline exceeded"}, {"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Remaining failed kubescape controls", "reason": "NSA reports 6 failed and MITRE 4 failed, but the digest details only 2 failed controls (C-0030, C-0013), so the others could not be assessed"}, {"item": "Skipped kubescape controls", "reason": "NSA and MITRE each report 5 skipped controls and the digest does not say which or why"}, {"item": "Image CVEs and misconfigurations", "reason": "No trivy results are in the digest because the trivy scan failed"}, {"item": "Repos", "reason": "The digest contains no repo scan data"}]}
